name: Mindustry
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The tower-defense factory game, hosting a multiplayer map. Installs any Mindustry release, checked against GitHub's checksum.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Mindustry. Downloads the server jar of the chosen release from Anuken's
# GitHub releases and checks it against GitHub's checksum. Maps, saves and
# settings in config/ are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
case "$want" in latest | v*) ;; *) want="v$want" ;; esac
tag=$(gh-release tag Anuken/Mindustry "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "Mindustry has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as v146."
sum=$(gh-release assets Anuken/Mindustry "$tag" | awk '$1 == "server-release.jar" { print $2 }')
[ -n "$sum" ] || fail "Mindustry $tag has no server download. Choose another version."

if [ -f server-release.jar ] && [ "$(sha256sum server-release.jar | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Mindustry $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading the Mindustry $tag server"
    gh-release download Anuken/Mindustry "$tag" server-release.jar server-release.jar ||
        fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
fi
echo "Installed Mindustry $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Mindustry release, such as v146, or latest for the newest. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description players see in the server list, or off for none.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map to host, with _ for spaces: Ancient_Caldera, Fortress, Glacier, Islands, Labyrinth, Maze, Tendrils, Veins, or one of your own in config/maps.
